sections.template: Tonight the frontier remembers {{completedStoryCount}} resolved tales and {{ignoredStoryCount}} missed opportunities.

rules.text: A starving prospector was carried into town and repaid the kindness.
A desperate prospector was left to the wild, and the wild answered.
The White Buffalo was spared, and a hush fell over the plains.
The White Buffalo was hunted, and fortune came with a shadow.
Lost Spanish gold was brought again into the light.

sections.template: So ends another chapter in the West, where every bootprint becomes rumor and every rumor becomes legend.
